title: RELATED inside SUMX reads the one-side value for each iterated row
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "ListPrice", SUMX ( Sales, RELATED ( Product[Price] ) ) )

source.quote: The RELATED function needs a row context
source.supports: RELATED works in the row context of an iterator such as SUMX

derivation: Price of each row's product: rows 1, 5, 7 Bike 100; rows 2, 3 Helmet 20; rows 4, 6 Lock 10. 3 x 100 + 2 x 20 + 2 x 10 = 360. Price is a fixed decimal column, and so is its sum.
